note: 浏览器内置网页「摆渡新闻」（《第四轮设计》第二节）。只在游戏的假浏览器里显示，不访问真实网址。date = 出现日期（游戏日历到了才显示，之前的都在列表里往下排）；kind = 娱乐 / 科技 / 体育 / 社会 / 水文；首页每天显示最新 8 条，水文穿插在中间并带「推广」小字。brief = 只有标题、点不开（政治、讣告类）。不出现 2016 年以后的事。

articles.title: 震惊！这三种水果晚上吃等于吃砒霜
articles.titleEn: SHOCKING! Three fruits that are poison at night
articles.body: 专家提醒：晚上吃水果要注意。至于是哪三种，本文没有说。文末附养生茶购买链接。
articles.bodyEn: Experts warn: be careful with fruit at night. Which three? The article never says. Herbal-tea shop link at the bottom.

articles.title: 940 万考生今日走进高考考场
articles.titleEn: 9.4 million sit the gaokao today
articles.body: 全国卷一作文题是一幅漫画：考满分被亲，退步了挨巴掌。网友纷纷晒出自己当年的作文题。
articles.bodyEn: The national essay prompt is a cartoon: a kiss for full marks, a slap for slipping. Netizens share their own old prompts.

articles.title: 《魔兽》首日票房破 3 亿，影院凌晨场爆满
articles.titleEn: Warcraft takes ¥300m on day one; midnight screenings packed
articles.body: 不少观众穿着兽人 T 恤进场，影厅里此起彼伏「为了部落」。
articles.bodyEn: Plenty arrived in orc T-shirts; "For the Horde" echoed round the cinemas.

articles.title: 上海迪士尼今日开园，排队最长 3 小时
articles.titleEn: Shanghai Disneyland opens; queues up to three hours
articles.body: 开园当天游客冒雨排队。有人吐槽：一根火鸡腿 80 元。
articles.bodyEn: Visitors queued in the rain on day one. One complaint: ¥80 for a turkey leg.

articles.title: 1 比 3 落后翻盘！骑士夺得 NBA 总冠军
articles.titleEn: Back from 1–3! The Cavaliers win the NBA title
articles.body: 詹姆斯赛后跪地痛哭。克利夫兰 52 年来第一个职业体育冠军。
articles.bodyEn: LeBron wept on the floor. Cleveland's first major title in 52 years.

articles.title: 英国公投决定脱离欧盟
articles.titleEn: Britain votes to leave the EU

articles.title: 程序员为什么都穿格子衫？真相让人泪目
articles.titleEn: Why do programmers wear checked shirts? The truth will move you
articles.body: 因为格子衫耐脏、不用熨、买一送一。全文 3000 字，结论只有这一句。
articles.bodyEn: Because they hide stains, need no ironing and come buy-one-get-one-free. 3,000 words for that.

articles.title: 武汉连日暴雨，市民「出门看海」
articles.titleEn: Days of rain in Wuhan: residents 'go to see the sea'
articles.body: 多条道路积水过膝，有人在马路上划起了皮划艇。消防和志愿者连夜转移群众。
articles.bodyEn: Streets flooded knee-deep; someone paddled a kayak down the road. Firefighters and volunteers moved people overnight.

articles.title: Pokémon GO 全球爆红，国内玩家只能看
articles.titleEn: Pokémon GO goes global; Chinese players can only watch
articles.body: 外国人满街抓皮卡丘，有人走进喷泉，有人撞上电线杆。国内锁区，改 GPS 的玩家被封号。
articles.bodyEn: Abroad people roam the streets after Pikachu, into fountains and lamp posts. Here it's region-locked, and GPS fakers get banned.

articles.title: 《大鱼海棠》上映，十二年终于等到了
articles.titleEn: Big Fish & Begonia opens after twelve years
articles.body: 画面被夸「每一帧都能当壁纸」，故事评价两极。
articles.bodyEn: "Every frame a wallpaper," say fans. The story divides opinion.

articles.title: Prisma 刷屏：一键把自拍变成油画
articles.titleEn: Prisma everywhere: turn a selfie into an oil painting
articles.body: 朋友圈一夜之间全是梵高风格的自拍。背后是神经网络：一层看笔触，一层看构图。
articles.bodyEn: Overnight, every feed is Van Gogh selfies. Behind it: a neural network, one layer for brushwork, another for composition.

articles.title: 你的颈椎还好吗？每天坚持这 5 个动作
articles.titleEn: How's your neck? Five moves a day
articles.body: 第一个动作：抬头。第二个动作：低头。第三到第五个动作在付费课程里。
articles.bodyEn: Move one: look up. Move two: look down. Moves three to five are in the paid course.

articles.title: 「葛优躺」火了：二十年前的剧照成了今年最红表情包
articles.titleEn: The 'Ge You slouch': a 20-year-old still is this year's top meme
articles.body: 《我爱我家》里葛优瘫在沙发上的一幕被翻出来，配字「感觉身体被掏空」。
articles.bodyEn: Ge You sprawled on a sofa in an old sitcom, captioned "I feel hollowed out".

articles.title: 今天是 hongmengos 10 免费升级最后一天
articles.titleEn: Today is the last day of free hongmengos 10 upgrades
articles.body: 微软提醒：明天起升级要 888 元。不少用户表示：终于不弹窗了。
articles.bodyEn: Microsoft: from tomorrow it costs ¥888. Many users: finally, no more popups.

articles.title: 滴滴宣布收购优步中国
articles.titleEn: Didi announces it will buy Uber China

articles.title: 「我已经用了洪荒之力！」傅园慧采访爆红
articles.titleEn: 'I used my primal powers!' Fu Yuanhui's interview goes viral
articles.body: 游完半决赛不知道自己的成绩，得知后惊喜大喊。表情包一夜之间刷屏。
articles.bodyEn: She didn't know her semi-final time; when told, she shrieked with joy. Memes flooded the internet overnight.

articles.title: 我国成功发射世界首颗量子科学实验卫星「墨子号」
articles.titleEn: China launches Micius, the first quantum science satellite
articles.body: 卫星将测试量子密钥分发。网友：看不懂，但很厉害。
articles.bodyEn: It will test quantum key distribution. Netizens: no idea, but impressive.

articles.title: 中国女排时隔 12 年再夺奥运金牌
articles.titleEn: China's women's volleyball team wins Olympic gold after 12 years
articles.body: 决赛 3 比 1 逆转塞尔维亚。凌晨四点，很多人家的灯亮着。
articles.bodyEn: 3–1 over Serbia from a set down. At 4 a.m., lights were on in a lot of homes.

articles.title: 月薪三千和月薪三万的人，差在哪里？
articles.titleEn: What separates ¥3k and ¥30k earners?
articles.body: 差在作者想卖给你的那本书。
articles.bodyEn: The book the author wants to sell you.

articles.title: 「先定一个小目标，比方说先挣它一个亿」
articles.titleEn: 'First set a small goal, like earning a hundred million'
articles.body: 首富一句访谈成了全网造句模板。网友：我的小目标是先挣它一百块。
articles.bodyEn: One interview line from China's richest man becomes a meme template. Netizens: my small goal is a hundred yuan.

articles.title: 三星宣布召回 Note7：电池可能起火
articles.titleEn: Samsung recalls the Note7: batteries may catch fire
articles.body: 多国航空公司禁止在飞机上使用。段子手：这才是真正的「爆款」。
articles.bodyEn: Airlines ban it on board. Jokers: now that's a hot product.

articles.title: G20 峰会在杭州开幕
articles.titleEn: The G20 summit opens in Hangzhou

articles.title: iPhone 7 发布：取消耳机孔，新增亮黑色
articles.titleEn: iPhone 7: no headphone jack, new jet black
articles.body: 苹果称这是「勇气」。网友：勇气多少钱一个转接头？
articles.bodyEn: Apple calls it courage. Netizens: how much is courage per adapter?

articles.title: 中秋夜，天宫二号发射成功
articles.titleEn: Tiangong-2 launches on Mid-Autumn night
articles.body: 月饼还没吃完，空间实验室已经上天。
articles.bodyEn: Mooncakes not finished yet, and the space lab is up.

articles.title: 这 10 个习惯，正在悄悄毁掉你的电脑
articles.titleEn: Ten habits quietly killing your computer
articles.body: 第 7 条：开机不关。第 8 条：关机。全文推荐使用某品牌清理软件。
articles.bodyEn: No. 7: never switching it off. No. 8: switching it off. Recommends a certain cleaning app throughout.

articles.title: 谷歌公开图像描述模型：让电脑看图写一句话
articles.titleEn: Google open-sources an image-captioning model
articles.body: 谷歌公开了 Show and Tell 图像描述模型的 TensorFlow 实现。模型把图像识别与语言生成接起来，尝试为照片写一句说明。源码公开了，认错图的时候仍会写出一本正经的句子。
articles.bodyEn: Google released its TensorFlow implementation of Show and Tell. The model connects image recognition with language generation to describe a photograph. Open code does not stop a mistaken caption from sounding confident.

articles.title: 世界最大单口径射电望远镜 FAST 落成
articles.titleEn: FAST, the world's largest single-dish radio telescope, opens
articles.body: 口径 500 米，相当于 30 个足球场。它将寻找来自宇宙深处的信号。
articles.bodyEn: 500 metres across, thirty football pitches. It will listen for signals from deep space.

articles.title: 谷歌公布 GNMT，先用于中文到英文翻译
articles.titleEn: Google announces GNMT, beginning with Chinese-to-English translation
articles.body: 谷歌在 9 月 27 日介绍了神经机器翻译系统 GNMT；相关论文的第一版提交于 9 月 26 日。公告称，系统已用于谷歌翻译的中文到英文方向，其他方向将逐步推出，并非所有语言同时更换。作者也指出，它仍可能漏词、误译名称，处理整段上下文仍有限制。译文更顺，并不等于重要内容可以免核对。
articles.bodyEn: Google introduced GNMT on September 27; version one of its paper was submitted on September 26. The announcement said GNMT was serving Chinese-to-English requests in Google Translate, with other language pairs to follow. This was not a simultaneous change for every language. The authors also noted omissions, mistranslated names and limits on wider context. Smoother wording does not remove the need to check important material.
articles.rights: Original bilingual summary; no source article text, images or product assets reproduced.

articles.title: 美剧《西部世界》首播：机器人开始做梦
articles.titleEn: Westworld premieres: the robots start to dream
articles.body: 乐园里的接待员一次次被重置记忆，直到有一天，她们开始记得。
articles.bodyEn: The park's hosts have their memories wiped again and again, until one day they start to remember.

articles.title: 「蓝瘦，香菇」是什么梗？
articles.titleEn: What does 'lan shou, xiang gu' mean?
articles.body: 一位小哥失恋后用方言录了段视频：「难受，想哭」。口音一出，全网跟着说。
articles.bodyEn: A heartbroken guy filmed himself saying "sad, want to cry" in a thick accent. Now everyone says it.

articles.title: 鲍勃·迪伦获诺贝尔文学奖
articles.titleEn: Bob Dylan wins the Nobel Prize in Literature
articles.body: 今年的诺贝尔文学奖颁给了鲍勃·迪伦。
articles.bodyEn: This year's Nobel Prize in Literature goes to Bob Dylan.

articles.title: 神舟十一号发射，两名航天员将在太空住一个月
articles.titleEn: Shenzhou-11 launches; two astronauts to stay a month
articles.body: 景海鹏第三次飞天。他们会在天宫二号上种生菜。
articles.bodyEn: Jing Haipeng's third flight. They'll grow lettuce on Tiangong-2.

articles.title: 《文明 6》发售：「再来一回合」又害了一批人
articles.titleEn: Civilization VI is out: 'one more turn' claims new victims
articles.body: 有玩家称一抬头天亮了。同日《战地 1》发售，钱包表示扛不住。
articles.bodyEn: One player looked up and it was dawn. Battlefield 1 out the same day. Wallets surrender.

articles.title: PPAP 洗脑神曲：一支笔一个苹果，播放量破亿
articles.titleEn: PPAP: a pen, an apple, a hundred million views
articles.body: 一分钟的视频，一个豹纹大叔。听完一遍，你会一直哼。
articles.bodyEn: One minute, one man in leopard print. Hear it once and you'll hum it forever.

articles.title: 美国大选结果揭晓
articles.titleEn: US election results announced

articles.title: 双十一全天成交 1207 亿元
articles.titleEn: Singles' Day sales hit ¥120.7 billion
articles.body: 快递小哥表示：接下来一周不要跟我说话。阿里的 AI「鲁班」今年做了 1.7 亿张海报。
articles.bodyEn: Couriers: don't talk to me for a week. Alibaba's AI 'Luban' made 170 million banners this year.

articles.title: 乌镇街头跑起无人车
articles.titleEn: Self-driving cars on the streets of Wuzhen
articles.body: 互联网大会期间，十几辆无人车在乌镇试运营，游客排队试乘。
articles.bodyEn: During the internet conference, a dozen driverless cars ran trial rides in Wuzhen. Tourists queued to try.

articles.title: 隔夜菜到底能不能吃？
articles.titleEn: Are leftovers safe to eat?
articles.body: 能，冷藏好、热透就行。本文没有推广，编辑说想换换口味。
articles.bodyEn: Yes, if chilled and reheated properly. No advert this time; the editor wanted a change.

articles.title: 同一套神经网络，试着翻译多种语言
articles.titleEn: One neural network tries multiple languages
articles.body: 谷歌介绍了多语言神经网络翻译系统：同一个模型处理多种语言对。研究还观察到，模型能尝试训练时没有直接见过的语言对。能试着翻，不等于每句话都翻得对。
articles.bodyEn: Google described a multilingual neural machine translation system that handles several language pairs in one model. Researchers also observed attempts at pairs not directly seen during training. Trying an unseen pair does not guarantee a correct translation.

articles.title: 《最终幻想 15》发售：玩家等了十年
articles.titleEn: Final Fantasy XV is out, ten years on
articles.body: 四个男人开车旅行。有人说是公路片，有人说是露营模拟器。
articles.bodyEn: Four guys on a road trip. A road movie, or a camping simulator, depending who you ask.

articles.title: 《你的名字。》内地上映，首日票房七千多万
articles.titleEn: Your Name opens on the mainland with over ¥70m on day one
articles.body: 散场后很多人站在影院门口不想走。「我们是不是在哪里见过？」
articles.bodyEn: Many lingered outside afterwards. "Haven't we met somewhere?"

articles.title: 人民币兑美元跌破 6.9
articles.titleEn: The yuan falls past 6.9 to the dollar

articles.title: 王菲演唱会最贵票 7800，比一张显卡还贵
articles.titleEn: Faye Wong's top ticket: ¥7,800, more than a GPU
articles.body: 跨年夜一场，「幻乐一场」。显卡吧：看不懂，但我们算了一下。
articles.bodyEn: One night on New Year's Eve. The GPU forum: no idea, but we did the maths.

articles.title: 2016 年度十大网络流行语，你用过几个？
articles.titleEn: 2016's top ten internet phrases: how many did you use?
articles.body: 洪荒之力、葛优躺、蓝瘦香菇、小目标、吃瓜群众……看完这一年就过去了。
articles.bodyEn: Primal powers, the Ge You slouch, lan shou xiang gu, small goals, melon-eaters… and the year is gone.

articles.title: 神秘棋手 Master 网上连胜中日韩高手
articles.titleEn: Mystery player Master beats top Go players online
articles.body: 已经连赢几十盘，一盘没输。没人知道它是谁。
articles.bodyEn: Dozens of wins, no losses. Nobody knows who it is.

articles.title: 回看三月围棋赛：AlphaGo 以 4 比 1 战胜李世石
articles.titleEn: Looking back at March: AlphaGo beats Lee Sedol 4–1
articles.body: 今年三月，AlphaGo 在首尔与李世石进行了五局围棋比赛，最终以 4 比 1 获胜；李世石赢下第四局。这是围棋任务上的重要结果。它并不能单凭这一场比赛证明，程序在所有工作上都同样可靠。
articles.bodyEn: In March, AlphaGo played five games of Go against Lee Sedol in Seoul and won the match 4–1. Lee won game four. This was an important result on a specific task; the match alone does not establish equal reliability in every kind of work.
articles.rights: Original bilingual summary; no source article text, images or product assets reproduced.

articles.title: 聊天程序早已上网：从小冰聊起
articles.titleEn: Chatbots were already online: a look at XiaoIce
articles.body: 微软小冰在 2014 年推出，到今年已经有公众与它聊天的经历。能顺着一句话接下去，是一种可以观察的表现；要判断它记住了什么、能否换个情境继续回答，还需要分别验证。这里不把流畅聊天等同于每轮都在训练模型。
articles.bodyEn: Microsoft launched XiaoIce in 2014, and by this year people had already been chatting with it. Continuing a conversation is observable behavior. What it remembers and whether it can answer in a different situation require separate checks. Fluent conversation does not establish that each exchange trains the model.
articles.rights: Original bilingual summary; no source article text, images or product assets reproduced.

articles.title: 回看 Tay 事件：开放互动还需要防范恶意输入
articles.titleEn: Looking back at Tay: public interaction needs protection from abuse
articles.body: 微软在 3 月 25 日的说明中表示，聊天机器人 Tay 上线后的头一天遭遇了针对漏洞的协同攻击，出现不当输出，随后下线。官方承认防护存在疏漏。这一事件说明开放互动需要应对恶意使用；仅凭一条输出，不能断定模型内部具体更新了什么。
articles.bodyEn: In its March 25 account, Microsoft said Tay faced a coordinated attack exploiting a vulnerability within its first day online, produced offensive output, and was taken offline. Microsoft acknowledged a gap in its safeguards. Public interaction needs defenses against abuse; an output alone cannot establish what changed inside a model.
articles.rights: Original bilingual summary; no source article text, images or product assets reproduced.

articles.title: 读去年公开的残差网络论文：深度之外还有结构
articles.titleEn: Reading last year’s residual-network paper: structure matters too
articles.body: 去年十二月公开的残差网络论文，把学习目标改写为相对输入的变化，并采用跨层连接。作者报告了更深网络的训练结果，包括 152 层网络的实验。这个方法帮助优化深层网络，却不表示层数加得越多，任何任务都会自动变好。
articles.bodyEn: The residual-network paper made public last December reformulates learning around changes relative to the input and uses shortcut connections. Its authors report results for deeper networks, including experiments with 152 layers. The approach helps optimize deep networks; it does not mean adding layers automatically improves every task.
articles.rights: Original bilingual summary; no source article text, images or product assets reproduced.

articles.title: 语音助手早已进入日常工具
articles.titleEn: Voice assistants were already everyday tools
articles.body: 苹果在 2011 年发布 iPhone 4S 时介绍了 Siri，列举了拨打电话、安排提醒等用途。到 2016 年，语音助手已经不是全新的概念。不同设备、语言和环境下的体验仍要分别看，能完成一类操作，也不表示什么事都能交给它。
articles.bodyEn: Apple introduced Siri with its iPhone 4S announcement in 2011, listing uses such as calls and reminders. By 2016, voice assistants were already an established idea. Experiences still depend on the device, language and setting. Handling one kind of operation does not make an assistant reliable for every job.
articles.rights: Original bilingual summary; no source article text, images or product assets reproduced.
